name: Protein Architect
tagline: Analyses protein interactions with structure models and agent research summaries for drug discovery.

awards: YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator

problem: Drug development is slow and costly, often because protein interactions are misunderstood.
solution: Combines protein-language and structure models with agentic literature research and 3D visualisation of interactions and drug-use suggestions.
demo_moment: Team-described: query a protein and see interactions in 3D with cited research.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator” among 195 submissions.

lessons: Science-heavy demos need a visual (3D structure) to reach non-experts.
